label: Rearranging by inverse operations
subgoals: Identify the operations applied to the target variable.
Undo addition or subtraction before multiplication or division.
Write the target variable alone on one side.

label: Substituting known values
subgoals: Substitute each known value into the rearranged formula.
Compute the numerator and denominator separately.
Report the result with the correct unit.

label: Checking the rearranged formula
subgoals: Substitute the recovered value into the original formula.
Compare the result with the given value.
Detect a sign error or a reversed division.
